signed_spherical_contract: Each beta multiplies B*N-sum_ij g(t_ij). The actual origin is0, h=beta*B*chi/2, diagonal=-beta*g(1)*chi and pair=beta*kappa_s*chi. The signed cyclic term must be included before sign verification. The count gauge uses the complete pair including that diagonal.
full_pair_count_gauge_contract: Attach w=-q/(1-psi) only after every unlifted contribution, including both capacities and the signed spherical diagonal, enters q. Fresh exact q<=0 and all local proofs are mandatory.
